verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Plaid's hosted Dashboard MCP server, which exposes Production diagnostics and analytics tools (Item debugging, Link conversion data, usage metrics). An external AI agent can use these to generate insights from a customer's Plaid data. Nothing shows AI-generated insights or suggestions built into Plaid's own Dashboard, so the story is met only through an outside AI client. Missing for 10: native in-product AI insights or suggestions, documentation of AI-generated recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
